name: Hikime Tei
source:
Tei serves as the shrine maiden for Oribe Shrine in Arakawa, and attends high school in the same area, where she is the archery club president. She's a quiet, bespectacled girl who prefers to use a bow in battle.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
